articles.title: The UK government wants you to stockpile, but why? | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 英国政府希望你储存，但为什么？ |英国广播公司新闻
articles.summary:
Major retailers have reported a big rise in sales of tinned food, bottled water, wind up radios and batteries, after the government launched its 'be ready' campaign.

The government is urging people to stock up on enough for three days in case of a crisis - like extreme weather or a cyber-attack. 

The security minister's defended the campaign, arguing that our European neighbours seem better prepared.

In this video...

0:00 – Montage
0:36 – Why is the government urging people to stockpile? 
2:02 – How serious is the threat to the UK?
2:48 – What should people be stockpiling?
3:59 – Rise in the sales of radios and tinner good, say retailers
5:29 – People give their reaction to the government advice
6:25 – How does the UK compare to other countries? 

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#BBCNews #Stockpile #UK #Preparedness #Prepper

articles.title: 'Separation of church & state doesn't exist' says Hegseth faith adviser
articles.titleZh: “政教分离不存在” ， Hegseth信仰顾问说
articles.summary:
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s senior adviser for religious issues has shared scores of racist and homophobic posts, spread conspiracy theories, and repeatedly denigrated Islam and immigrants, a CNN investigation has found. Ryan Higgins has become a key aide to Hegseth since joining the Pentagon, multiple sources familiar with the matter told CNN, particularly in shaping the defense secretary’s embrace of Christian nationalist themes in speeches and public appearances.

On his social media platforms, CNN found Higgins defended a video President Donald Trump shared depicting the Obamas as apes, said same-sex marriage was “abominable,” and speculated about how many abortions former Vice President Kamala Harris might have had, citing her age and claiming she had a “long record of sleeping around.”

CNN senior investigative reporter Allison Gordon shares her reporting and Rep. Adam Smith of the Armed Services Committee reacts to Higgins' posts.

0:00 CNN uncovers Higgins' racist and homophobic posts
0:50 Higgins says "separation of church and state does not exist"
3:22 Adam Smith reacts to these posts
5:50 Could Hegseth be out after the midterms?

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#News #military

CNN senior investigative reporter Allison Gordon shares her reporting and Rep.

Adam Smith of the Armed Services Committee reacts to Higgins' posts.
articles.readingTextZh:
美国有线电视新闻网（ CNN ）的一项调查发现，国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯（ Pete Hegseth ）的宗教问题高级顾问分享了数十个种族主义和仇视同性恋的帖子，传播阴谋论，并一再诋毁伊斯兰教和移民。

多位知情人士告诉美国有线电视新闻网（ CNN ） ，自加入五角大楼以来，瑞安·希金斯（ Ryan Higgins ）已成为黑格塞斯（ Hegseth ）的关键助手，特别是在塑造国防部长在演讲和公开露面中接受基督教民族主义主题方面。

在他的社交媒体平台上，美国有线电视新闻网发现希金斯为唐纳德·特朗普总统分享的将奥巴马夫妇描绘成猿的视频辩护，称同性婚姻是“令人憎恶的” ，并推测前副总统卡马拉·哈里斯可能有多少次堕胎，理由是她的年龄，并声称她有“长期的睡眠记录”。

美国有线电视新闻网高级调查记者艾莉森·戈登（ Allison Gordon ）分享了她的报道和众

军事委员会的亚当·史密斯（ Adam Smith ）对希金斯的职位做出了反应。

articles.readingText:
The polls for prime minister of Israel closed Tuesday in one of Israel’s most significant elections in its history and the first since the deadly Hamas-led October 7, 2023, attacks.

Voter turnout reached its highest level since records began in 1973, according to the Central Elections Committee.

CNN's Jeremy Diamond breaks down the high-stakes race between Benjamin Netanyahu and ex-military chief Gadi Eisenkot.
articles.readingTextZh:
以色列总理的民意调查于周二结束，这是以色列历史上最重要的选举之一，也是自2023年10月7日致命的哈马斯领导的袭击事件以来的首次选举。

根据中央选举委员会的数据，选民投票率达到了自1973年有记录以来的最高水平。
